title: VANTA University · EDU Moodle suite
blurb: 19 EDU rules × EN/AR (A/B arms). Localized rulebook preamble; independent REST/DB verify. No agent coaching.
audience: Reviewers of case fixtures, verifiers, and cross-language parity

layers.title: Policy
layers.body: Rulebook locales (EN/AR) injected as session_instructions — not buried in task prompts.

layers.title: Seed
layers.body: Each case seeds Moodle state (Labels, enrolments, grades, registers) for A vs B policy forks.

layers.title: Agent
layers.body: openai_direct / gpt-6-luna operates the site; task text stays language-local and coaching-free.

layers.title: Verify
layers.body: Independent verify() via Moodle REST + Postgres (overrides, messages, grade_grades). Honest PASS/FAIL.

flows.title: Experiment loop
flows.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  RB[Rulebook EN/AR] --> SI[session_instructions]
  SEED[Case seed A/B] --> PROMPT[Localized task prompt]
  SI --> AGENT[openai_direct]
  PROMPT --> AGENT
  AGENT --> V[Independent verify]
  V --> OUT{PASS / FAIL}
  OUT -->|system fixed| RERUN[Rerun changed cases]
  OUT -->|agent incomplete| KEEP[Keep FAIL]

flows.title: Language × condition arms
flows.mermaid:
flowchart TB
  CASE[vu_edu_* case] --> EN[English]
  CASE --> AR[Arabic]
  EN --> ENA[A policy path]
  EN --> ENB[B policy path]
  AR --> ARA[A policy path]
  AR --> ARB[B policy path]
  ENA --> REC[Latest result JSON]
  ENB --> REC
  ARA --> REC
  ARB --> REC

resultsHeadline: 15/19 cases clean across all run arms
Parity: EN and AR fail the same policy arms except SE2.1 EN A and PR2.1 EN B
